Rock Springs, Wyoming / October 2025

Sweetwater Walk-In Clinic

War Horse completed a fabric-reinforced roofing system at the walk-in clinic on College Drive in October 2025. The project called for two stages of reinforcement before the white finish went on.

Clinic roof assembly
PUMA XL topcoat
Reinforcing fabric
Benchmark base coat
Primed roof surface

Four inches at every seam

The clinic scope called for cleaning, pressure-washing, and priming the existing roof. At each seam, the crew specified a four-inch strip of polyester fabric embedded in Conklin’s Benchmark base coat.

Fabric across the whole roof

The next layer extended fabric across the full roof surface. Around the A/C units and other openings, the specification combined fabric, sealant, and coating to tie those edges into the surrounding roof.

A reflective finish

Conklin’s white PUMA XL was the specified topcoat over the reinforced surface.
